title: Latency Sculptor: Route & Model Inspector for Token-aware Performance
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact, token-aware Route & Model inspector called 'Latency Sculptor' that surfaces per-model and per-route latency, throughput, and token metrics with cost-layering and rollout context. This ticket covers the exploratory prototypes, chart specs, accessibility pass, and a review-ready Figma deliverable for engineering handoff. The goal is to help engineers and SREs quickly diagnose tail latency vs token-distribution issues and correlate them with model variants and rollout state.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype with desktop + condensed mobile layouts linked and comment thread resolved
Chart spec document (CSV-friendly) listing metrics, aggregation windows, and axis conventions
Design tokens and component variants exported (microcards, radial timelines, waterfall charts)
Interaction specs for hover drill, timeframe sync, and compare-mode (two routes/models)
Accessibility checks (contrast, keyboard navigation) completed and noted
design_notes: Core idea: combine a radial 'latency sculptor' that shows percentile shapes by token-slice with a horizontal throughput waterfall and an adaptive token heatmap below
Latency sculptor uses layered percentiles (P50/P90/P99) as concentric spline bands; inner band = lower percentiles, outer = tail. Band width represents median token count for requests in that bucket
Throughput waterfall shows request time broken into queueing | model_compute | encode_decode; stacked bars per-minute with dynamic smoothing
Token heatmap rows = model variant (or route model alias), columns = token-length buckets; color = median latency; overlays indicate canary vs primary rollout state
Cost layering: small inline sparklines show approximate cost-per-request (normalized units) and cumulative cost in left gutter for selected timeframe
Syncing: time-range selection applies across all three panels; compare-mode pins a second trace with dashed lines and lower opacity
Progressive disclosure: collapsed microcard summary shows P50/P90/P99 + RPS + avg tokens; expand reveals full sculptor and waterfall
decisions: Chose radial percentile bands over violin plots because radial view emphasizes tail curvature and is compact for route lists (decision made after PM/Eng alignment call)
Use percentile bands smoothed with monotonic cubic splines to avoid visual spikes from sampling noise
Adopt relative color ramp (green->amber->red) with a tunable threshold in Console settings; thresholds are provided by SRE defaults but editable by workspace admins
Prefer client-side aggregation for prototype (for interactive demos). Engineering will evaluate server-side downsampling for production due to data volume
Token buckets: 0-32,33-64,65-128,129-256,257-512,>512 chosen to align with most common request length distributions observed in telemetry (proposal based on runtime sampling)
tradeoffs_and_risks: Radial charts are less common — learning curve for some users vs dense tabular layouts. Mitigation: provide inline legend and short tour
Client-side smoothing gives interactive feel but can hide transient spikes; engineering to add 'raw sampling' toggle in debug mode
Token heatmap with many variants may become vertically long. Introduced variant collapse by default to show top 5 by traffic with 'show all' option
Embedding cost overlay approximates GPU microsecond cost and may not match billing exactly; include explicit disclaimer and a link to cost-export for exact billing
review_comments: Priya Natarajan (PM): Replace absolute color labels 'fast/slow' with 'meets SLO / warning / exceeds SLO' to reduce ambiguity
Diego Martins (Eng): Need explicit sampling window details in chart spec; client-side smoothing parameters added to spec doc
Sofia Petrov (SRE): Add overlay for outage/region-failover markers on the timeline; implemented marker layer in prototype
Liam O'Connor (Design): Requested keyboard navigation patterns for focus on microcards and expand/collapse actions
chart_spec_summary: Latency Sculptor (radial): metrics=P50,P90,P99; aggregation=1m/5m selectable; bucket by token-length; radial radius scaled to P99; smoothing=monotonic-cubic, downsample=1000samps
Throughput Waterfall: metrics=request_count, queue_ms, compute_ms, encode_ms; stacked area with per-minute resolution; negative space highlights tail compute spikes
Token Heatmap: metric=median_latency; buckets=0-32,33-64,65-128,129-256,257-512,>512; color-scale linear with percent-of-SLO as value
Microcard Summary: fields=[route_name, model_alias, RPS, avg_tokens, P50,P90,P99, cost_estimate]; accessible label strings provided for screen readers
